param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string[]]$Candidates)
# Launch each candidate agentshield.exe once as an extra Claude Code
# PreToolUse hook (--settings), from where it sits, so the installed binary and
# any running MCP proxy are untouched. Reports whether Defender removed it.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# powershell -File passes "a,b" as one string; split it here.
$Candidates = $Candidates -split ','
$start = Get-Date
"launch at $start"
Set-Location 'C:\shield4717\cc-work'
foreach ($exe in $Candidates) {
  $label = Split-Path (Split-Path $exe -Parent) -Leaf
  if (-not (Test-Path $exe)) { "[$label] gone before launch"; continue }
  "[$label] sha256=" + (Get-FileHash $exe).Hash.Substring(0, 12)
  $cfg = Join-Path (Split-Path $exe -Parent) 'hook-settings.json'

  $null = claude -p 'Use the Bash tool once to run `echo shield-check`, then reply with its output only.' --allowedTools Bash --settings $cfg 2>&1
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
  "[$label] present after launch: " + (Test-Path $exe)
}
Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -MaxEvents 40 |
  Where-Object { $_.Id -in 1116, 1117 -and $_.TimeCreated -ge $start } | Sort-Object TimeCreated | ForEach-Object {
    $m = $_.Message
    "defender id=$($_.Id) " + ([regex]::Match($m, 'Name:\s*(\S+)')).Groups[1].Value + " " +
      ([regex]::Match($m, 'Path:\s*(\S+)')).Groups[1].Value

param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Candidate, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Label)
# Does Defender quarantine this agentshield.exe when Claude Code launches it as
# its PreToolUse hook? Puts the candidate at the install path, makes one
# harmless Bash call through Claude Code, and reports what Defender did.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$dir = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs\AgentShield'
$exe = Join-Path $dir 'agentshield.exe'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null
$start = Get-Date
Copy-Item $Candidate $exe -Force
Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
$hash = if (Test-Path $exe) { (Get-FileHash $exe).Hash.Substring(0, 12) } else { 'gone' }
"[$Label] copied; present after write: " + (Test-Path $exe) + " sha256=" + $hash
$audit = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.agentshield\audit.jsonl'
$before = @(Get-Content $audit -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
Set-Location 'C:\shield4717\cc-work'
$null = claude -p 'Use the Bash tool once to run `echo shield-check`, then reply with its output only.' --allowedTools Bash 2>&1
Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
$after = @(Get-Content $audit -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Count
"[$Label] present after hook run: " + (Test-Path $exe) + "; new audit lines: " + ($after - $before)
$hits = Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational' -MaxEvents 30 |
  Where-Object { $_.Id -in 1116, 1117 -and $_.TimeCreated -ge $start }
if ($hits) {
  $hits | Sort-Object TimeCreated | ForEach-Object {
    $m = $_.Message
    $name = ([regex]::Match($m, 'Name:\s*(\S+)')).Groups[1].Value
    $proc = ([regex]::Match($m, 'Process Name:\s*(.+)')).Groups[1].Value.Trim()
    "[$Label] defender id=$($_.Id) $name by $proc"
  }
} else { "[$Label] defender: no detection" }

# The workbook's "Bash only" apply and undo snippets, verbatim. (1) on a file
# that already has an env object with another variable, (2) on the box's real
# settings.json with a real Claude Code session, then undo. Real file restored.
function Apply-Snippet {
  # --- workbook apply text starts
  $f = "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\settings.json"
  $j = Get-Content -Raw $f | ConvertFrom-Json
  if (-not $j.env) { $j | Add-Member -NotePropertyName env -NotePropertyValue ([pscustomobject]@{}) }
  $j.env | Add-Member -NotePropertyName CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL -NotePropertyValue '0' -Force
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, ($j | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20))
  # --- workbook apply text ends
}
function Undo-Snippet {
  # --- workbook undo text starts
  $f = "$env:USERPROFILE\.claude\settings.json"
  $j = Get-Content -Raw $f | ConvertFrom-Json
  if ($j.env) { $j.env.PSObject.Properties.Remove('CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL') }
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($f, ($j | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20))
  # --- workbook undo text ends
}
